reviews.text: I proceeded with this company due to their overall ratings score and personal experiences with the contractors. I decided to hire them for my lack of time and for the convenience to sand and seal a 10x12 wood shed. The contractor Mark was very pleasant, but the work provided was not what I expected and subpar. As per the after photo, the right side of the shed was belt sanded, which I requested for the paint spots that were there, however the left side was hardly sanded, splotchy and the corners ignored. I recently had the pleasure of working with Mr. Handyman of Burleson, Midlothian, and E Cleburne, and I can't recommend them enough! From start to finish, my experience was fantastic.

The worker (Mark) who came to my home was not only friendly but also incredibly knowledgeable. They took the time to listen to my concerns and offered helpful advice throughout the entire process. It was clear that they really cared about doing a great job and ensuring I was satisfied with the results.

The quality of work was top-notch, and I appreciated their attention to detail. They tackled my needs of installing 4 ceiling fans in my home with professionalism and skill, making the entire experience smooth and stress-free.

If you're looking for reliable and friendly handyman services, look no further than Mr. Handyman! I'm already planning to call them again for future projects. Thank you for a job well done!

reviews.text: If I could give more stars, I would!!!!  Raymon and Tyler were professional, efficient, and did a fantastic job! They did all of the work in a timely manner without rushing it! They were very personal in helping me choose the color of the new vanity, they made it their mission to help me find the perfect color, and vanity, and when the vanity they bought was found to have a small crack as they were installing it, they immediately returned it, and found out it was out of stock, so they had a new one ordered and shipped directly to my house with instructions to notify them as soon as it was received, (which was on a Saturday), they were there 1st thing Monday morning installing it and sealing everything up! I will and already have recommended them to friends and family! They went above and beyond after my son's toilet busted overnight and flooded half the house, everything looks amazing!! When I found a tiny leak a week later, that most likely wasn't even a cause of anything they did, Raymon came back that same day and had it fixed and had us back up and running!! We can not recommend them enough. We will be using them again anytime we need repairs!

reviews.text:
Rebecca, who is the face and voice of the company, is the first one you will interact with. She is outstanding and provides top-notch customer service; the level of service you rarely see anymore. Always helpful, friendly, and patient. She answer each and every question with patience, no matter how many times you call.

There is no waiting 10-20 minutes for the "next customer service representative" as many companies do these days. They are truly engaged with their customers.

Mark who fixed our garage ceiling was very professional, quick, knowledgable and friendly. He was great! He came in, got the job done quickly, and provided quality work.

The owner is pleasant as well and seems to have happy employees which reflects on how he runs his business. I would highly recommend this company. Thanks, Mr. Handyman of Burleson! I will remain a customer.

(I rarely post Google reviews, so this tells you I was quite impressed.)

reviews.text:
I read the positive reviews and decided to give them a chance, and I couldn't have been more disappointed in their service.

I asked for an itemized quote of a few different things in our house that needed repairs, and the quote they gave me wasn't itemized, and it didn't even have all the items we asked for.

It took two weeks of calling to get them to do anything, and they only gave me an itemized estimate (still missing the breakdown) after I threatened to dispute the $75 they charged up front.

The itemized estimate was all over the place and not broken down at all. For example, they wanted to charge hundreds of dollars to replace a light in the kitchen. I had someone else come out and quote it and replace it for about $50 (it was 15 minutes of work).

When I told them I wasn't happy with their service, I asked for a refund. They basically told me to kick rocks because "the franchise owner doesn't do refunds"...

There are better companies in the area, just stay away from these guys. You shouldn't have to spend two weeks calling them back, being told you'll get a call back, and then never hearing back just to get a quote.

I disputed the charge with my bank and was refunded.

The repairman spent time in our bathroom, running to his car and talking to us only to turn around and charge us for his break time.

When we called Rebecca at the Mr. Handyman, she acknowledged that they overcharged us and said we would receive a credit for the discrepancy. Months later, we hadn’t receive it… continued to follow up… she then acted as if she never said that and instead tried to get us to book another service with them so they could “discount” that service to us. reviews.text: I was given an estimate and inquired about financing due to the cost. The office manager said she would look into it. She emailed me about the delay getting me the info but then didn't return my call when I didn't receive it. I was very patient and understanding with her. So I sent her an email modifying my original project since I could not afford to pay for the whole project with no financing option, and to get back with me on a few questions regarding the original estimate. When I called again to follow up on my email after getting no response, I left a message with another office worker to have her call me back.....no callback. After a month had passed since I had them out to give me the estimate, I called again only to have her tell me that they were not going to do the project because I wanted to put a band-aid on it. That was not what I communicated to them. Instead of clarifying with me what I sent them, they assumed something different. She claimed they sent me the financing information, but I did not receive anything. Poor communication and follow-up on their part! I am very disappointed in my experience with them based on their previous reviews from other customers.
